brief:
Sliman Mansour, a leading figure in contemporary Palestinian art, has died at age 79, according to Middle East Eye. His family announced his death through a post on his Instagram account, stating: "The final chapter has been written." The announcement marked the end of a decades-long career that established Mansour as a central voice in Palestinian artistic expression.

Mansour's work spanned generations and helped define the trajectory of modern Palestinian visual culture. His contributions to the field secured his position among the most influential artists to emerge from the region.
